exact_failure: The comparable-cycle proof for punctured covers requires the actual Jacobian divisor R_f to be exceptional and bounded coefficientwise by lambda times the exceptional parameter cycle C. A cover tame along a nonempty original divisor has horizontal Jacobian terms. Even x=u^e,y=v for e prime to p has generic horizontal different exponent e-1. An exceptional C has horizontal coefficient zero, so R_f<=lambda C cannot hold on such a cover, for any lambda. This is a failure of this substitution, not a counterexample to a logarithmic repair or to the desired hereditary theorem.
possible_repair: The formal horizontal cancellation R_f+D_A_prime-f^*D_0_prime removes e-1+1-e at a tame branch. One still needs a uniform exceptional log-Jacobian bound on an appropriate relative-minimal model, degree-linear geometry, and an actual canonical all-coefficient-ring parabolic Noether/Frobenius factorization with the required inverse and gluing equations. None has been proved here.
old_packet_scope: The fixed-pair root-stack theorem is uniform in horizontal root orders and supplies full coefficient gerbes and exact marked finite-cycle atlases on one fixed log resolution. It does not prove those geometric or canonical uniformities over arbitrary degree-t boundary covers. The radial-tame earlier theorem covers a different exceptional-divisor hypothesis.
